named_subject: a duck (a bird with a short flat bill and webbed feet) seen in side profile, facing left
action: The duck stands in place in profile while its head bobs and tilts slightly up and down; the body and feet stay almost still.
identity_gap: The animated character is the doodle mirrored left-to-right with the same outline, bill line, eye dot and triangular feet, though the feet are drawn smaller and more evenly spaced than in the doodle.
notes: The film shows the duck turning its head from profile to face the camera, crying tears, and turning back to profile at the end, but the animation keeps the head in profile and only moves it by a few pixels, with small jumps in head position at frames 4, 5 and 16. The change that would help most is to turn the head toward the viewer over frames 3 to 15 (bill foreshortened, both eyes visible) and back again at frame 16, as the film does.
